messages:
evan: tossing an idea over the wall: 'staggered shadow orbit' for canaries. mirror small slices of traffic for telemetry + occasional brief real-traffic bursts to validate end-to-end. want thoughts on safety vs cost.
evan: core goals: cheap continuous signal, low-affinity (no long-lived sessions), clear autoswitch fallback, and minimal infra changes.
sophia: love the name :) how do you avoid mirror noise from cold-starts? mirrors still pay GPU cycles.
eevan: typo: evan :) plan: mirror-only by default, run lightweight probes that exercise KV cache and short prompts every N secs, then promote a tiny % of real traffic for 30s windows if probes look good.
nina: question: how do we choose which hosts to shadow? random vs deterministic?
evan: staggered assignment: deterministic hash -> cohort mapping, rotate cohorts every 10m; that spreads warmup cost and reduces blast radius.
otar: rotating cohorts will still hit session affinity. we should limit to endpoints with affinity_scope=none or short.
sophia: agree. start with stateless generate + embeddings. chats with multi-turn should be separate experiment.
omar: runtime work: add header `X-Shadow-Tag: cohort-42` so control-plane can force. runtime should honor header and not attach session token unless warmup ok. fallback to stable variant if host lacks warmup.
deploy-bot: note: any forced cohort promotions should post to #eng-oncall with TTL and link.
sre-bot: operational proposal: stripe-level circuit: if consecutive_errors >= 4 OR p95 > baseline*1.3 -> mark cohort degraded for 3 rotations. also correlate with host GPU util.
nina: we should treat saturated host differently. host-metric spike => capacity flag so control-plane avoids conflating capacity issues with variant regressions.
evan: agreed. plan to show both variant divergence and host health panels.
sophia: what gates to use for brief real-traffic bursts? evan: propose gates: p95 delta pct < 12, error_delta_pct < 0.4, probe-quality-score >= baseline-0.4. realtime gates block bursts, async evals can revoke later.
omar: how compute probe-quality-score? use 5 canonical small prompts, compute BLEU-ish or embedding-sim similarity. not perfect but quick.
nina: can we reuse warmup snapshots instead of synthetic probes? snapshot transfer increases startup time and storage; maybe opt-in for big models.
evan: yeah make warmup-snapshot opt-in flag in rollout config. default: synth probes.
sophia: add a decay/forgiveness window before rollback. don't revert on a single 1-min blip. specify consecutive failing windows threshold.
Tara: UX: here's a minimal rollout schema idea:
```
rollout:
  strategy: staggered_shadow
  cohorts: 8
  cohort_rotation: 600s
  probe_interval: 20s
  real_burst_pct: 0.5
  real_burst_window: 30s
  gates:
    p95_delta_pct: 12
    error_pct_delta: 0.4
    probe_quality_drop: 0.4
  warmup_snapshot: optional
  affinity_scope: none
```
Tara: note real_burst_pct tiny to keep cost low.
sre-bot: add dashboard panels per-cohort: p95, error%, qscore, GPU mem, queue. alert when cohort diverges > threshold.
evan: rollback semantics: two tiers. SEV: immediate - safety/TOX violation -> auto-fallback to stable and notify oncall. WARN: quality/latency regressions -> pause rotations, gradual drain, and block promotion until resolved.
sophia: control-plane vs runtime boundary: control-plane schedules cohorts and issues `X-Shadow-Tag` or a sticky assignment. runtime must expose readiness for cohorts (warmup state) and fast fallback.
mar: small nit: name service API: GET /runtime/cohort_status?cohort=42 returns READY|WARMING|UNHEALTHY. runtime should rate-limit status calls.
evan: good call. will include in RFC draft.
nina: cost note: mirrored infer *and* brief bursts increase cost. include cost cap per rollout (e.g., 5 GPU-min per hour) to auto-throttle.
sophia: next steps: evan to draft RFC with config schema, runtime header, cohort-status endpoint, dashboard panels, and rollback/playbook. include a simple prototype plan for stateless generate endpoints.
evan: will do. tagging @eng-oncall and @eng-runtime for review when draft ready. :v:
